text:
Type: rectangular seagrass storage basket
Use: storing small items, towels or papers on a shelf or in a cabinet; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, coastal, Japandi
Materials: tightly woven natural seagrass, off-white cotton fabric binding along the rim and base
Colors: light natural straw beige, off-white trim
Shape: low rectangular open box with straight sides, a finely striped woven texture, soft fabric-bound edges, compact and tidy
Feel: natural, calm, tidy, warm
Goes with: open shelving, light wood, white walls, linen and cotton textiles; Scandinavian, Japandi or coastal rooms

product.name: SLNAN
product.description: Seagrass has natural colour variations which makes every basket unique.
